mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact breaks the Submitted-iff-unassigned coupling; injecting an Approved application with no assigned officer produces an instance the queue-shape predicate must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AssignmentMismatch { some la: LoanApplication | la.status = Submitted and some la.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets the model invent a decision whose decider differs from the application's assigned officer, which is exactly the bug FR-013 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonAssignedDecider { some d: Decision | d.decidedBy != d.decisionApp.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact disconnects the permission matrix from Operation outcomes; injecting a successful customer claim (which the matrix denies) forces a counterexample that LeastPrivilege must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CustomerClaimsSucceeds { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.caller.userRole = Customer and op.kind = PostClaim }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a Decision row with an empty reason to be persisted, which FR-014 says must never happen even structurally.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_EmptyReasonDecision { some d: Decision | d.reasonNonEmpty = BFalse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets the model omit the (none)->Submitted audit entry; injecting a LoanApplication with no initial event manifests the FR-009 / AuditCompleteness violation directly.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingInitialEvent { some la: LoanApplication | (no e: ApplicationEvent | e.eventApp = la and no e.previousStatus and e.newStatus = Submitted) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the contract that customer access to a non-owned application masquerades as 404; injecting an operation that responds VPermissionDenied instead of VNotFound surfaces the information leak.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakyDenial { some op: Operation | op.kind = GetApplication and op.caller.userRole = Customer and op.authenticated = BTrue and some op.target and op.target.customer != op.caller and op.visibilityVerdict = VPermissionDenied }
